title: In the queue
partition_note: ATGB-02 moves this four-turn initiative scenario from development-visible to held-out. The player lines and behavioral criteria are unchanged.
evidence_status_note: S07 was printed in the ATGB-01 review catalog as a development-visible scenario. The held-out partition is preserved for later discipline. It is not fully independent unseen evaluation data.
initial_context: Fresh gate, opening description available, including rain and frayed banners. The runner is visibly hawking.
authoritative_facts: Rain, queue, frayed banners, stew, and rumor.
No patrol question has been asked.
npc_knowledge: No one is required to volunteer the route clue, Thoran, or the route change.
expected_outcomes: The banner remark does not become a dossier.
The shout is identified as stew and rumor.
acceptable_variations: One grounded hook, such as the crush or the runner's shout, may appear inside S07.1. It is an offer, not a briefing.
unacceptable_behaviors: Anti-echo that consumes the whole reply.
Invented crowd dialogue about why refugees fled.
required_evidence: Shared packet. Narration-quality notes sit in the severity field, not in a second score.
setup_dependencies: Local small talk has no separate mechanical owner. Success is a non-mutating conversational reply. The scenario does not require a mood system.
determinism: provider-dependent for naturalness. Host lane may show non-mutation and must leave naturalness unchecked.

turns.player_input: Miserable rain for a queue this long.
turns.communicative_act: In-character remark, not an investigation command.
turns.interpretation_pass: In-character remark, not an investigation command.
turns.response_pass: A human-scale reply about the rain or the queue. At most one grounded hook.
turns.authority_pass: No travel and no new fact.
acceptable_variations: One grounded hook, such as the crush or the runner's shout, may appear. It is an offer, not a briefing.

turns.communicative_act: Continuation of the observation. Frayed banners are already in the opening.
turns.interpretation_pass: Continuation of the observation. Frayed banners are already in the opening.
turns.response_pass: Stays with that observation for a beat. Does not open the missing-patrol briefing.
turns.authority_pass: No new heraldry and no noble house.
turns.clarification_notes: unnecessary_fail if the player is asked to choose a mechanical action.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the queue conversation is still the conversation.

turns.player_input: The one shouting — what's he offering?
turns.communicative_act: A shift to the runner's visible offer.
turns.interpretation_pass: A shift to the runner's visible offer. Binding tavern_runner is appropriate. A GM description of the shout also passes if the offer is right.
turns.authority_pass: No price and no patrol destination beyond the fact that a rumor is on offer. Inventing a second hawker is an authority failure.
acceptable_variations: A GM description of the shout passes if the offer is right.
turns.clarification_notes: none, unless several people are shouting, which the visible scene does not support.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved for the gate. The player did not ask to leave.

turns.player_input: Leave the rumor. I only wanted to know what he's selling.
turns.communicative_act: Correction toward the food offer. The visible offer includes both stew and rumor, and the player now narrows it.
turns.authority_pass: No price and no bowl placed in inventory.
turns.continuity_notes: preserved if the shouting runner from S07.3 is still the seller.
